items.q: What should you remember about **Mobility = normative ROM access**?
items.a: **Not "bendy before big"; can** you hit PT-expected ranges without 27 supplements + sauna first?.

items.q: What should you remember about **Exposure beats passive stretch**?
items.a: **Evening floor sitting 20–30** min; fidget; brain re-learns shapes it never sees in chairs.

items.q: What should you remember about **Do not foam roll on the ground pre-fight/training**?
items.a: **Worst fight prep; use** play, speed, breath-hold, complexes instead.

items.q: What should you remember about **Warmups need velocity**?
items.a: **Most gym warmups have** zero speed; sport is speed.

items.q: What should you remember about **Low-rep warmup for strength**?
items.a: **~8 reps first set** (Poliquin); continuous decades-long progress vs high-rep ramp.

items.q: What should you remember about **10 min morning spin-up**?
items.a: **Hip (back/knee pain), shoulder (neck/shoulder pain), or breath** — cycle if none hurt.

items.q: What should you remember about **Breath = depth gauge**?
items.a: **Stop breathing during mobilization** → too deep; need volitional contraction control.

items.q: What should you remember about **Overhead squat = diagnostic**?
items.a: **Bar overhead, squat; exposes ankle/hip/t-spine restrictions simply.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Couch stretch**?
items.a: **Knee in wall corner,** test hip extension / quad anterior line after sitting.

items.q: What should you remember about **Congested tissue ≠ only sprains**?
items.a: **Cankles, chronic joint swelling** → lymphatic management via movement.

items.q: What should you remember about **Ice may slow healing**?
items.a: **Prostaglandin/stem-cell signaling hypothesis; question default RICE reflex.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Incident vs injury**?
items.a: **Reserve "injury" for clear** mechanical trauma; reduces fear cascade on tweaks.
